# Challenge Rating

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#ChallengeRating)*

Challenge Rating (CR) summarizes the threat a monster poses to a group of four player characters. Compare a monster's CR to the characters' level. If the CR is higher, the monster is likely a danger. If the CR is lower, the monster likely poses little threat. But circumstances and the number of player characters can significantly alter how threatening a monster is in actual play. The [Dungeon Master's Guide](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/dmg-2024) provides guidance to the DM on using CR while planning potential combat encounters. *See also* "[Stat Block](Stat-Block.md)."
